body: Galion Research keeps three piles and says which one a sentence came from: found, inferred, unknown. R3 uses a matching reading rule for its own note: a fact names who said it, when, and where; an opinion is a design choice and is not a measurement. This knowledge pack uses four labels, because the schema asked for them: fact, interpretation, opinion, and contested. Found maps to fact. An inference we are willing to show maps to interpretation, and it is announced as a reading. A design choice or a value maps to opinion. A live disagreement maps to contested, and the sides stay in the card rather than being averaged. Do not move a sentence into 'found' by sounding sure. Tone is not a pile.
